sections.text:
Finite volume solution to heat transfer by Mikkel Mollerup.
   Used by movement rectangle heat (see 56.2, page 307) .
  < Mollerup (solver solver ) ; Default cxsparse value.
                  (debug 0) >

    solver : solver component (see chapter 82)
     Component (default ‘cxsparse’)
     Model used for solving matrix equation system.
    debug: integer
     Parameter (default 0)
     Enable additional debug message. A value of 0 means no message, higher
     numbers means more messages.
